newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: N.Korean sergeant defects to South, Seoul says.
newsitem.headline: N.Korean sergeant defects to South, Seoul says.

text.p: A North Korean soldier defected to South Korea through the Demilitarized Zone (DMZ) dividing the two Koreas, a spokesman for Seoul's Defence Ministry said on Sunday.
"A sergeant defected today, but I can't give details because we are still investigating the case," he told Reuters.
Local television reported that Sergeant First Class Kwak Kyoung-il had defected across the eastern part of the tense border line.
Meanwhile, a massive manhunt continued on Sunday for three of the 26 North Korean infiltrators who came ashore last month after their submarine ran aground off the east coast city of Kangnung.
So far 22 of them have been killed by South Korean soldiers or found dead and one has been captured alive.
